Privacy and writing-process evidence

Work and run timestamps are saved in this browser on this device. Keep the same browser and web address. Clearing browser data or using private browsing may remove that backup; download before closing.

The QR records timings, editing counts, clipboard attempts, focus changes, word-count spikes and response checksums. It does not record raw keystroke content, other websites, audio, video or location. Dictation and assistive input can affect patterns, so the teacher reviews context. Nothing is automatically uploaded.

One sitting · notes allowed · maximum one hour. Finish and export before closing.

What counts as critical thinking?

Evaluate means weigh strengths and limitations to reach a judgement. A limitation earns its place when you explain how it affects what can be concluded.

1 · IdentifyA specific strength, assumption or limitation.
2 · ExplainIts consequence for the inference.
3 · WeighHow much it matters and what is still justified.

Evaluation belongs throughout the response, including evidence paragraphs. These boxes are a planning scaffold, not a compulsory point–counterpoint formula.
